metadata.bridgeDefinition: isBridge = non-cornerstone with at least one anchored 7-35 parent and at least one anchored non-7-35 parent (multi-family junction).
metadata.rootConvention: root is the canonical scale root of the concrete set (Ionian 7-35, harmonic minor orientation-A 7-32, major pentatonic 5-35, lexicographically minimal orbit representative otherwise); tonic is mode context and is distinct from collection root.
metadata.universeDefinition: All 12-bit pitch-class sets of cardinality 5 (330) and 7 (462) that contain pc 0; node IDs are {forteTnI}:{root} with orientation-B nodes suffixed B. pitchClasses are listed in rooted order from root.
